blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The Dancesport Team Cebu City (DTCC) capped its campaign with eight gold medals, 13 silvers, and nine bronzes in the Philippine Dancesport Federation, Inc. (PDSFI) 4th Quarter National Dancesport Championships 2026 over the weekend at the Ninoy Aquino Stadium in Manila. Francis Isaiah Diluvio and Pauline Venice Duba led DTCC’s medal haul when they topped two events, winning the Grand Slam Rising Star A Latin and Special Event 1A Latin categories. They also bagged a bronze medal in Grade B Latin. Southeast Asian Games (SEAG) gold medalists Wilbert Aunzo and Pearl Marie Caneda also struck gold, ruling Grade A […]...
